name: Kawana Misaki
source:
Misaki is an upperclassman of [url=/c4766]Kouhei[/url] who lost her eyesight in an accident in elementary school. She meets Kouhei on the roof of school during sunset. Despite her blindness, she has no wariness against other people, and has a sociable personality, being unreserved with everybody. Her house is right in front of the school, so she can get to school even by herself. She used to play around in the high school even before she lost her eyesight, so she is used to it. She is a surprisingly big eater, and there is a scene where she eats several people's worth of curry at the cafeteria. She often shows up at the theater club to help her best friend [url=/c4883]Yukimi[/url].

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160112194234/http://www.en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_One:_Kagayaku_Kisetsu_e_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
